subject: Moving our Tuesday meeting
text: Hi neighbor, As your customer for the home-workshop series, I need to move Tuesday's planning session to Thursday at 7:30. My priorities shifted this week because the repair job on my porch now has to happen before I can finish the project I mentioned. I apologize for the short notice. The new time works if the porch is done, but I'll be flexible if another evening is easier for everyone. Please let me know by tomorrow evening so I can update my calendar and the flyer. If Thursday doesn't work, Wednesday after eight could still be possible, though I'd rather keep the original thirty minutes. I still have the handout PDF ready. Send a quick yes or no so I can lock it in.
